page.notes: Marginal note at right, top: "Ejusdem censura acerba Missalis Romani Gallice editi" (set in italic and roman lines). Catchword "mo-" at foot right is a hyphenated line-end word, treated as the last line's continuation. Some ink smudging on the right side; "Ecclesiasticas" and "Sacro-sancti" transcribed as printed. Head "CCXC." is a paragraph number and was kept in the paragraph, so the head tag is not a true heading.
